scope: Independent retained-evidence audit of one R146 Oracle monitor candidate; no new sampling and no device access

decision.reason: Frozen monitor mean/R136 gate did not pass; daemon CPU savings, caller CPU or memory observations cannot override it. No threshold change, extension or alternate candidate.

frozen_policy.scope: R142 Oracle monitor screen; no router acceptance
frozen_policy.schedule: All six permutations of labels, in itertools.permutations order; serial subjects and modes, with a fresh daemon per case.
frozen_policy.decision: Candidate/R136 monitor mean ratio median strictly below 0.97 and at least five of six blocks below one. Reject if any of three modes times mean/p95/p99 has ratio median strictly above 1.03 and at least five of six blocks above one.
frozen_policy.numeric: Recompute latency, wall and process-clock metrics from raw integers. Use exact Fraction ratios and medians for all strict thresholds.
frozen_policy.interpretation: Report candidate versus both C and R136 on every metric. Inclusive plus/minus 1% is unresolved, not equivalence. CPU and C comparisons are descriptive, with no extra hard gate.
frozen_policy.stopping: One frozen monitor-only generic candidate, exactly 54 cases; no selected blocks, retries or extra samples to rescue the screen.
frozen_policy.limits: Original 1705 helper: small payload, one monitor, caller poll/validation included in latency. Separate large-message memory guard and exact candidate correctness remain required; no claim of fixing unmonitored registration tails.

metric_definition.latency: Mean of raw latency_ns; quantile index ((N-1)*percent+50)//100, no interpolation. Nanoseconds converted to microseconds.
metric_definition.wall_and_cpu: Raw wall_ns, daemon_cpu_ns and caller_cpu_ns divided by N*1000.
metric_definition.cpu_sum: For each case first add raw daemon_cpu_ns+caller_cpu_ns, divide by N*1000, then pair candidate/control sums within the same block. Never add percentage changes or subtract CPU from wall.
metric_definition.ratios: Exact Fraction candidate/baseline per block. Median of six ratios, strict frozen comparisons; floats only for display.
metric_definition.statistical_unit: Six paired blocks, not 108000 independent comparative observations. Inclusive +/-1% unresolved is not equivalence.

build_and_units.timing_provenance: The only archived timed series is bound to source-02/build-02 and the 62-test proof; source-01 has build evidence only.

correctness.fd_scope: Three sender-framed cases match C exactly; three handcrafted cases match the pre-existing read-ahead contract, not C placement. Witness, order, single-delivery/no-leak and FD recovery remain required.
correctness.recovery_interpretation: C expected failures remain failures of behavior; passed means matching the pre-existing expected-defect classification. The original lookup-delete subject exited -11. Candidate passes both behaviors.
correctness.native_subject_note: Historical folder label r134 denotes this candidate; the extra native control is R131, not R136.
correctness.retained_checks_limit: Wire and FD transcripts were compared directly. Native/monitor/memory payload and FD assertions are the retained helper checks; no new probe or offline replay of unretained payload bytes was performed.

memory.scope: One sample-mode run per C/R136/candidate, eight phases at 1s and 5s each; descriptive residency only.
limits: VmHWM is process resident-memory high-water, not an exact heap/allocation peak.
RSS/RssAnon/VmData snapshots do not measure all transient allocations or kernel socket memory, and are not a repeated statistical comparison.
Large-message residency cannot replace the unchanged small-message monitor latency gate.

evidence.hash_index_encoding: UTF-8 compact sorted JSON relative-path to SHA256 mapping

limitations: Oracle/aarch64 results do not establish Cortex-A53/router performance or adoption.
Original helper includes polling, receipt and validation; profiles, correctness checks and memory residency do not replace the frozen latency gate.
No R136 lifecycle tail loss or prior R142 rejection is withdrawn.

deviations_and_limits.detail: The frozen policy has nine hard latency veto checks against R136. Across C and R136 there are eighteen latency comparison groups, forty-two original seven-metric groups, and six additional daemon-plus-caller CPU groups. C comparisons have no hard gate.

Wire and dedicated monitor checks use C/R136/candidate. FD uses C/R131/candidate, and the twelve native checks also use C/R131/candidate. Historical native folder label r134 is the candidate, not an R134 control.

Three sender-framed cases match C. The candidate's three handcrafted cases match its pre-existing read-ahead contract; all three retained candidate c_placement values are false, so full C placement equivalence is not claimed.
Original C incomplete half-close reply and lookup-delete failure with subject exit -11 are retained expected defects, not rewritten as successful C behavior.

Three single-case residency runs and 48 snapshots are descriptive. Full mirror byte checks are retained helper assertions; the ten raw mirror frames per case were not retained for independent byte replay. VmHWM is a process RSS high-water mark, not an exact heap peak.

Source-01 to source-02 adds two tests and a Linux test cfg; the full candidate release ELF is byte-identical. The sole archived timing series is bound to source-02/build-02; no source-01 timing is included.

Oracle results cannot establish A53/router performance. CPU savings and memory observations cannot rescue the unchanged failed latency gate; the combined CPU measure is a per-case sum, not wall time or a sum of percentage changes.

audit_method.computation: One inline standard-library audit, without importing the collector's metric or comparison functions; Fraction arithmetic for recomputation and gate decisions.
